  CLAUDE_MODEL: "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022"
  
  # System Configuration
  MAX_RETRIES: "3"
  REQUEST_TIMEOUT: "30"
  
  # Security Configuration
  DEBUG_MODE: "false"
  STRICT_MODE: "true"
  ENFORCE_HTTPS: "true"
  RATE_LIMITING_ENABLED: "true"
  LOG_SECURITY_EVENTS: "true"
  
  # Authentication Configuration
  AUTH_TOKEN_LIFETIME: "3600"
  
  # Rate Limiting Configuration
  RATE_LIMIT_USER_PER_MINUTE: "60"
  RATE_LIMIT_TOOL_PER_MINUTE: "30"
  RATE_LIMIT_AUTH_PER_MINUTE: "5"
  
  # Input Validation Configuration
  VALIDATION_MAX_STRING_LENGTH: "10000"
  VALIDATION_ALLOW_HTML: "false"
  VALIDATION_ALLOW_JAVASCRIPT: "false"
  
  # Monitoring Configuration
  SECURITY_LOG_LEVEL: "INFO"
  SECURITY_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS: "90"
  ENABLE_INTRUSION_DETECTION: "true"
  
  # Network Security Configuration
  BLOCK_PRIVATE_IPS: "true"
  BLOCK_LOCALHOST: "true"
  
  # Redis Configuration
  REDIS_HOST: "fact-redis"
  REDIS_PORT: "6379"
  REDIS_DB: "0"
  
  # PostgreSQL Configuration
  POSTGRES_HOST: "fact-postgres"
  POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
  POSTGRES_DB: "fact_db"
  POSTGRES_USER: "fact_user"
---
# Application Configuration File
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fact-app-config
  namespace: fact-system
  labels:
    app: fact
    component: app-config
data:
  app.conf: |
    [server]
    host = 0.0.0.0
    port = 8000
    workers = 2
    
    [database]
    pool_size = 10
    max_overflow = 20
    pool_timeout = 30
    pool_recycle = 3600
    
    [cache]
    default_ttl = 3600
    max_size = 1000
    eviction_policy = LRU
    
    [security]
    session_timeout = 1800
    max_login_attempts = 5
    lockout_duration = 300
    
    [monitoring]
    metrics_enabled = true
    health_check_interval = 30
    performance_tracking = true
---
# Nginx Configuration
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: fact-nginx-config
  namespace: fact-system
  labels:
    app: fact
    component: nginx
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    user nginx;
    worker_processes auto;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/error.log warn;
    pid /var/run/nginx.pid;
    
    events {
        worker_connections 1024;
        use epoll;
        multi_accept on;
    }
    
    http {
        include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
        default_type application/octet-stream;
        
        # Logging format
        log_format main '$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] "$request" '
                        '$status $body_bytes_sent "$http_referer" '
                        '"$http_user_agent" "$http_x_forwarded_for"';
        
        access_log /var/log/nginx/access.log main;
        
        # Performance optimizations
        sendfile on;
        tcp_nopush on;
        tcp_nodelay on;
        keepalive_timeout 65;
        types_hash_max_size 2048;
        client_max_body_size 10M;
        
        # Gzip compression
        gzip on;
        gzip_vary on;
        gzip_min_length 1024;
        gzip_types text/plain text/css application/json application/javascript text/xml application/xml application/xml+rss text/javascript;
        
        # Security headers
        add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;
        add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
        add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block";
        add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
        
        # Rate limiting
        limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api:10m rate=10r/s;
        limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=auth:10m rate=1r/s;
        
        upstream fact_backend {
            least_conn;
            server fact-app:8000 max_fails=3 fail_timeout=30s;
            keepalive 32;
        }

# FACT System Alert Rules
groups:
  - name: fact-application
    rules:
      # Application Health Alerts
      - alert: FACTApplicationDown
        expr: up{job="fact-app"} == 0
        for: 1m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service: fact-app
        annotations:
          summary: "FACT application is down"
          description: "FACT application has been down for more than 1 minute"

      - alert: FACTHighErrorRate
        expr: rate(fact_http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m]) / rate(fact_http_requests_total[5m]) > 0.05
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service: fact-app
        annotations:
          summary: "High error rate in FACT application"
          description: "Error rate is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} for more than 5 minutes"

      # Performance Alerts
      - alert: FACTHighResponseTime
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(fact_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.5
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service: fact-app
        annotations:
          summary: "High response time in FACT application"
          description: "95th percentile response time is {{ $value }}s for more than 5 minutes"

      - alert: FACTCacheHitRateLow
        expr: rate(fact_cache_hits[5m]) / (rate(fact_cache_hits[5m]) + rate(fact_cache_misses[5m])) < 0.8
        for: 10m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service: fact-cache
        annotations:
          summary: "Low cache hit rate"
          description: "Cache hit rate is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} for more than 10 minutes"

      - alert: FACTMemoryUsageHigh
        expr: (fact_memory_usage_bytes / fact_memory_limit_bytes) > 0.9
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service: fact-app
        annotations:
          summary: "High memory usage"
          description: "Memory usage is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} for more than 5 minutes"

  - name: fact-infrastructure
    rules:
      # Database Alerts
      - alert: PostgreSQLDown
        expr: up{job="postgres"} == 0
        for: 1m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service: postgres
        annotations:
          summary: "PostgreSQL is down"
          description: "PostgreSQL database has been down for more than 1 minute"

      - alert: PostgreSQLHighConnections
        expr: pg_stat_database_numbackends / pg_settings_max_connections > 0.8
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service: postgres
        annotations:
          summary: "High number of PostgreSQL connections"
          description: "PostgreSQL connection usage is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}"

      # Redis Alerts
      - alert: RedisDown
        expr: up{job="redis"} == 0
        for: 1m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service: redis
        annotations:
          summary: "Redis is down"
          description: "Redis cache has been down for more than 1 minute"

      - alert: RedisMemoryUsageHigh
        expr: redis_memory_used_bytes / redis_memory_max_bytes > 0.9
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service: redis
        annotations:
          summary: "High Redis memory usage"
          description: "Redis memory usage is {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}"

      # System Resource Alerts
      - alert: HighCPUUsage
        expr: 100 - (avg by(instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100) > 80
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: warning
          service: system
        annotations:
          summary: "High CPU usage"
          description: "CPU usage is {{ $value }}% on {{ $labels.instance }}"

Config deployment/monitoring/prometheus.yml:
# FACT System Prometheus Configuration
global:
  scrape_interval: 15s
  evaluation_interval: 15s
  external_labels:
    cluster: 'fact-system'
    environment: 'development'

# Rules and alerts
rule_files:
  - "alerts/*.yml"

# Scrape configurations
scrape_configs:
  # Prometheus self-monitoring
  - job_name: 'prometheus'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['localhost:9090']

  # FACT application metrics
  - job_name: 'fact-app'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['fact-app:8000']
    metrics_path: /metrics
    scrape_interval: 10s
    scrape_timeout: 5s
    honor_labels: true

  # Redis metrics
  - job_name: 'redis'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['fact-redis:6379']
    metrics_path: /metrics

  # PostgreSQL metrics
  - job_name: 'postgres'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['fact-postgres:5432']
    metrics_path: /metrics

  # Node exporter for system metrics
  - job_name: 'node-exporter'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['node-exporter:9100']
    scrape_interval: 15s

  # cAdvisor for container metrics
  - job_name: 'cadvisor'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['cadvisor:8080']
    scrape_interval: 15s

  # Nginx metrics
  - job_name: 'nginx'
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['fact-nginx:9113']
    metrics_path: /metrics

# Alertmanager configuration
alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets:
          - alertmanager:9093

# Recording rules for performance optimization
rule_files:
  - "rules/*.yml"

# Remote write configuration (for long-term storage)
remote_write:
  - url: "http://thanos-receive:19291/api/v1/receive"
    queue_config:
      max_samples_per_send: 10000
      max_shards: 200
      capacity: 2500
